name: HarmonicForceEngine
description: This engine adds a harmonic (sinusoidal) force to a set of bodies. It is identical to HarmonicMotionEngine except a force amplitude is prescribed instead of motion, see also the `dynamics of harmonic motion <http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Simple_harmonic_motion#Dynamics_of_simple_harmonic_motion>`__

attributes.name: fi
attributes.description: Initial phase [radians]. By default, the phase is zero such that the force starts at zero.
